mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need professional water damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: You likely need professional water damage restoration if the water intrusion is extensive, covers a large area, involves contaminated water (e.g., sewage), or has been present for more than 24-48 hours. Professionals have the specialized equipment and expertise to safely extract water, thoroughly dry materials, and prevent mold. Attempting a DIY approach for significant damage often leads to incomplete drying and hidden issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional restoration is needed for extensive damage, contaminated water, or if water has been present over 24-48 hours, due to specialized equipment and mold prevention expertise.
